evidence: Full CDIAL karṇa explicitly gives Kalasha kuṛõ/kᵘṛũ/kṛä̃, broader reduced nasal-vowel reflexes, and regional kān/kāna ear. Kalasha kụ̃/kạ/kʰạ̃, Bhatri kan.o and Dogri ka are provisionally grouped with that family, retaining the survey loss of rhotic or nasal segments, aspiration and punctuation exactly. The short Kalasha and Dogri forms require qualified local phonetic histories; no new intermediate stem is asserted. Regional IA transmission remains unresolved.
